name: Eldorado Plaza
summary: Eldorado Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in McKinney, Texas, managed by Whitestone REIT. With a 4.5-star rating from nearly 1,200 reviews, it serves as a convenient community destination for local residents seeking everyday retail and services.
demographics: Eldorado Plaza serves the affluent McKinney, Texas market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area draws from McKinney's growing suburban population, which skews toward families with children and young professionals aged 25-54. Shoppers in this area demonstrate strong preferences for convenience-oriented retail, everyday services, and neighborhood dining options that support their active suburban lifestyles.
description: Eldorado Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located at 2811-2975 Craig Drive in McKinney, Texas, serving the thriving North Dallas suburban community. Managed by Whitestone REIT, a Houston-based real estate investment trust specializing in community-centered retail properties, this plaza has become a trusted destination for local residents seeking convenient access to everyday services and retail options. The center maintains strong community ties with consistent operating hours from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, accommodating the busy schedules of McKinney families and professionals. With an impressive 4.5-star rating from nearly 1,200 Google reviews, Eldorado Plaza has earned its reputation as a reliable neighborhood gathering place. The shopping center's strategic location on Craig Drive positions it within one of McKinney's most accessible retail corridors, making it an integral part of the daily routines of local residents who value quality, convenience, and community-focused shopping experiences.
